name: Kimi to Boku to no Kishi no Hibi -Rakuen no Chevalier-
original_name: きみと僕との騎士の日々 -楽園のシュバリエ-
source:
This is the first title by piriri!, a sister brand of UnisonShift, Hearts and Qoobrand, under the AMUSE CRAFT company. 

It is said that one who graduates from the famous private school Kamishiro Gakuen will definitely become successful in life. The best students at the school are called ‘knights’ and are admired by all. This year, five good childhood friends were selected as the ‘knights’: sourpuss Yukitaka, serious Kei, cheerful Ruruka, timid Asuna and cool Touri. Even though he had some feelings for all of them, he spent his days without pursuing any deeper relationships. That was until he found out about a secret ‘duel game’ which only the knights can participate in.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/01/01/january-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是AMUSE CRAFT旗下品牌piriri!推出的第一部作品；piriri!是UnisonShift、Hearts和Qoobrand的姐妹品牌。

据说，从著名私立学校神城学园毕业的人必定能在社会上取得成功。学校里最优秀的学生被称为“骑士”，受到所有人的憧憬。今年，五名关系要好的青梅竹马被选为“骑士”：刻薄的幸隆、严肃的圭、开朗的露露卡、胆小的亚丝娜，以及冷静的透里。男主角虽然对她们都抱有感情，却一直没有进一步发展关系。直到有一天，他得知了一场只有骑士才能参加的秘密“决斗游戏”。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/01/01/january-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
